title: I Opened 99 Queenslayer Chests in RuneScape Dragonwilds 1.0
author: SuperStooob
chapters: Could we have missed a 1% drop?
description:
Thanks for showing love recently and checking out the videos! big love!

I opened 99 Kuldra reward chests in RuneScape Dragonwilds to see what loot turned up and how often. Dragon armour, Dragon weapons and Kuldra’s Wrath: here’s the full chest opening and results breakdown.

DISCLAIMER FOR U GUYS: For science: these Queenslayer reward packs were spawned in using a mod. I did NOT kill Kuldra 99 times! This is a loot experiment, and the percentages reflect my 99 openings-not confirmed official drop rates.

If you’re farming Kuldra in the Scorned Wilderness and chasing a particular reward, this gives you one recorded sample of what the chests can contain.

00:00 99 Kuldra chests —-the experiment
00:39 Opening the first chests
01:50 First Dragon crossbow
02:11 Dragon med helm & stats comparison
03:03 First Kuldra’s Wrath
04:02 Loot after 30 chests
05:36 Loot after 50 chests
06:03 Opening the remaining chests
08:35 Final loot results & percentages
09:13 Could we have missed a 1% drop?

Percentages are rounded. This sample doesn’t establish the complete loot table or rule out rarer rewards.

What have you received from Kuldra-and which item are you still chasing? Let me know your chest count and drops in the comments.

Subscribe for more RuneScape Dragonwilds guides, gear tests and update coverage.

#RuneScapeDragonwilds #Dragonwilds #Kuldra
